reader.requirement: At --std 85 the figurative ALL literal not associated with another data item (a DISPLAY operand; an ALPHABET literal-phrase operand of SPECIAL-NAMES, per the 1985 Annex's change note) is exactly the literal, once; and (the row's trailing sentence) a figurative constant may stand wherever a format writes 'literal', subject to the listed exceptions and each statement's own bans (STOP, STRING, UNSTRING and INSPECT refuse a figurative beginning with ALL). The witnesses exercise only DISPLAY ALL "AB"/ALL "XYZ".

reader.notes: The ALL-literal length itself conforms at 85: DISPLAY renders BoundAllLiteral as the literal once and SpecialNamesFigurative gives an ALPHABET operand literal-1's full characters; STOP/STRING refuse ALL by their own 1985 SRs. The row's trailing sentence ('A figurative constant may be used whenever literal appears in a format') is broken by STOP symbolic-character, a parse error - the same single defect recorded on 1985-GR-IV.4.2.2.2.3-L2.2 (grammar `literal` has no symbolic-character arm), so this row is PARTIAL on that sentence alone.
